# How Many Engagements Can I Run At Once

How many client engagements can I run in parallel without quality, research time or my evenings suffering?

## Evidence so far

- January to April 2025: Orchard & Vane overflow (3 days a week) plus Crumbhollow. Crumbhollow overran and stretched in calendar time ([[orchard-and-vane-overflow-last-day-2025-04-30]]).
- January to March 2026: Copperline foundations plus Ledgerleaf. Worked, because Ledgerleaf had a strong engineer and a clear metric; but foundations slipped two weeks.
- Autumn 2026: Copperline bill pay plus Tallowmere plus Lintel Kit V2. Tight. Tallowmere days fall on Thursdays and Fridays.

## Working rule

One large engagement plus one small one, and never two research-heavy phases in the same month. Product work on Lintel Kit counts as half an engagement.

## Why it is still open

Velora doubted that a solo designer had capacity ([[velora-feedback-call-2026-06-03]]). Named partners ([[imani-clarke]], [[bastian-kohl]]) change the answer for larger projects, but I have only subcontracted once. Revisit after phase 3 is decided ([[should-i-propose-copperline-phase-3]]).
